### Faith Is Counted
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/faith-counted
Passage: Romans 4:5
Points:
- In justification, God legally imputes Christ's perfect righteousness to those who trust Him.
- Righteousness is credited to believers rather than infused for them to complete by good deeds.
- Works of obedience necessarily flow from true faith, but they never form the ground of justification.
- Abraham and David stand as prime biblical examples that justification is by faith alone apart from works.
- Because Christ bore God's wrath on the cross, believers resting in Him need not fear divine condemnation.

### Justification by Faith
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/justification-by-faith
Passage: Romans 4:5
Points:
- Deep guilt and repeated spiritual failure often trap people in apathy and paralyzing hopelessness.
- The promise that God justifies the ungodly directly shatters despair.
- Connection to the Savior begins through trust rather than moral self-improvement.
- Through faith alone, God counts the ungodly as righteous entirely because of Jesus Christ.
- Fallen believers can endure seasons of darkness with confidence that the Lord will plead their cause.
